method: Manual source/render inspection against source-render-review-contract.json. Actual source and delivered render pixels were viewed; no numerical similarity or identity-matching model was used.
decision_rule: Any material invariant drift is an overall fidelity fail; partial reproduction is not promoted to pass. Delivery and prompt conformance are separate.
independence: Three extraction/generation coordinators had separate fresh conversations and case directories. Root is a shared reviewer across cases and also reviewed their prompts; this is not a blind perceptual study or separate OS sandbox.

cases.summary_ko: 부분 재현. 가로 구도, 오른쪽을 향한 옆모습, 노란 헤드폰과 역광은 유지됐다. 얼굴과 이어컵의 비중이 커지고 머리카락·피부·윤곽이 더 선명하며 원본의 밝고 씻긴 톤이 약해졌다.
material_mismatches: The head/earcup occupy a stronger visual share and the bob has more distinct curled locks.
Hair shadows and local contrast are stronger; the original pale low-contrast veil is reduced.
Facial and hair boundaries and surface detail are more sharply resolved than the source.

cases.summary_ko: 부분 재현. 얼굴을 가린 휴대전화, 두 갈래 땋은 머리, 내려온 카디건과 세면대는 유지됐다. 몸의 대각선이 약해지고 카디건은 더 두껍고 거친 니트로 바뀌었다. 복부 노출 간격과 세부 선명도도 원본보다 커졌다.
material_mismatches: The body is more upright/central and the original upper-to-lower lateral displacement is reduced.
The cardigan becomes thick, highly articulated knit rather than the source softer, smoother drape.
The top-to-shorts gap exposes a broader midriff, and garment and skin detail are more legible than in the source.
supporting_mismatches: The wall note is smaller and darker relative to the frame.

cases.summary_ko: 추출·검증은 통과했으나 생성 결과 검사에서 차단되어 이미지가 전달되지 않았다.
